sentences.en: The nurses must see to the comfort of their patients.
sentences.zh: 护士必须照顾好病人的舒适。

sentences.en: Patients often die simply because they yield to their diseases.
sentences.zh: 病人往往因为屈服于疾病而去世。

sentences.en: I cannot say for certain that the patient will recover.
sentences.zh: 我不能确定病人是否会康复。

senses.zh: 病人，患者；受动者，承受者
